## Definition of Done

- [ ] It meets the acceptance criteria in the issue.
- [ ] The model holds data only. Views render it, and controllers handle input and update the model.
- [ ] It works at phone width and on desktop.
- [ ] It works with the keyboard alone, and every input has a label.
- [ ] The browser console shows no errors or warnings.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] The README is updated if setup or features changed.
- [ ] The other team member has read the changes.
